title: Stanford Clock Tower
axis: +X follows Escondido Mall east-southeast. +Z follows the adjoining courtyard grid south-southwest.
source: USGS and USDA public-domain NAIP map, campus grid from OpenStreetMap, and Stanford’s visitor map. The tower does not have its own mapped OSM outline.
identityStatus: Campus visitor map places the clock tower at the Lasuen and Escondido Malls intersection. The federal map corroborates the base in the southeast quadrant and the adjoining colonnades. The exterior footprint and roof registration are approximate.
geometryLabel: Estimated tower shaft and attached pergola arms registered to the campus intersection

terrainContact.basis: Original source height on the intersection side of the tower steps.

notes: The freestanding 1983 Stanford Clock Tower at Lasuen and Escondido Malls, represented in February 2009. Includes its glazed base, four-sided bell chamber, clock faces, stone steps and the two immediately attached pergola arms. The nearby campus buildings and internal clockwork mechanisms are outside scope. The one exact cleared view shows two adjacent faces. Unseen sides use the symmetric shaft proportions, and the orientation and pergola dimensions are estimates.
